name: imda-ai-governance
description: Engineering reference for aligning agentic AI systems with Singapore IMDA's Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI (v1.5, 2026) — organised by where in the system each expectation lands (risk and bounding, identity, controls, human oversight, testing, monitoring, user transparency), with design-review, release-gate and change-review checklists. Also applies IMDA's Model AI Governance Framework for Generative AI (2024) as a supplement for the model, training / RAG data and generated content. Reference material only, not legal or regulatory advice; not affiliated with IMDA.
